description.value: Gyro Pool is a seasonal outdoor swimming pool located in Gyro Park in the center of Nelson. The pool operates during July and August with lifeguards provided through a partnership with the Regional District of Central Kootenay. The surrounding Gyro Park features curving flower gardens, a gazebo, and a spectacular rocky-outcrop viewpoint offering a bird's-eye view of Nelson's heritage downtown and waterfront.
